race.comment: CIRCUS MOON (10) sets the standard after going under by only a neck at Seymour, where he was slow away yet still made sustained late ground to worry Handsome Missile. The rise to 2000m should suit now, his profile is heading the right way and he looks ready to win. SOARING LEGEND (12) was only sixth on debut at Bendigo, beaten five and a half lengths, but he did make some late impression and comes from a stable with strong Grunt figures; he can take a sizeable step second-up. HOLD THIS (1) has the most consistent exposed record, with seven placings from 11 starts and a nose second at Wagga two runs back, though he was a beaten favourite last start and also sees 2000m for the first time. Nailed on for a top four finish again. MY ROSALIE (8) hit the line well when fourth at the Bool and her third-up profile gives her a genuine chance to keep improving.
